dedupe_keys.name: ifremer worldwide list of seaports version 2021

description: The IFREMER world list of seaports is a reference point dataset of 13,709 ports in 187 countries in its 2021 version. It was drawn up from the European reference system of places used under the Common Fisheries Policy, notably by the Electronic Recording and Reporting System (ERS), and the UNECE port list, and was completed by checking coastal infrastructure to add ports not referenced elsewhere; each location was checked in Google Earth. Each port has its country (ISO 3 code), five-character UNECE or ERS code, name, WGS 84 coordinates and a status showing whether it is referenced by UNECE, ERS or both; French overseas ports and, since 2021, inland ports are included. It is maintained by IFREMER in Lorient and described in the Sextant catalogue with a DOI. Coverage is global. Access: WFS and WMS services and files distributed through data.gouv.fr; the Sextant record states a Creative Commons BY-NC-SA licence. Caveats: the non-commercial licence limits reuse, and the list gives locations and codes only, without capacity or traffic. It supports geocoding of port calls and trade records, building port nodes for maritime network models and coastal hazard exposure screening, and complements the World Port Index and the Upply port list catalogued here.
